I took my cat here initially for a cyst that had ruptured. My first appointment they cleaned it and gave me some solution. I didn’t speak to a vet and was given vague instructions. I came back two weeks later and they did some blood work and gave me antibiotics for the cyst possibly being infected, again never saw or really spoke to any vet. They said come back in two more weeks. But after the medicine was done I noticed my cat looked worse and I took him to another Banfield location. They didn’t do anything for him either. The next day a vet from this location called me to tell me I should take my cat to the ER because the results from other visits showed he was really sick. I took him to the ER where I finally got answers and I ultimately had to put him down due to many failing organs and cancer. I feel like my month and a half of visits to Banfield weren’t very helpful, especially considering I got all the answers I needed at another vet in just one day. I never got clear instructions and felt like I was annoying staff by calling and asking about my cat. The front desk people were nice to my cat and myself. I wouldn’t recommend going here.

From start to finish the staff treated us and Lennon with empathy, love and patience. Explaining every step from tests to the treatment plan and follow up. The Vet Tech made the experience and even gave Lennon a pup cup after getting shots! The vet was sweet and took time to explain everything. Highly recommend!

I've taken both of my cats here for a variety of reasons and they've always been wonderful. Great communication on what we're doing and why. Being able to read the reports online is super helpful.

Most recently we an emergency situation with my kitten and they made a very scary situation a little easier. Even though there was a glitch with the website that let me double book a spot Dr. Mason and her team squeezed me in because they could tell it was urgent. The entire team was warm, compassionate, and loved on my kitten (Ursula) like she was their own. When things escalated and needed emergency care they had the best referral (veterinary animal group) and sent her medical records over before I arrived and made the transfer of care as easy as possible. Without their quick thinking and excellent care she might not have made it and I'm incredibly grateful to their team.

Dr. Mason is fantastic — truly caring and attentive. I really appreciate her and think she’s a great vet. The rest of the team is also made up of kind and friendly people, which makes visits more pleasant.

That said, the biggest downside to this Banfield location is the wait times. In my experience, they tend to run significantly behind schedule. I made morning drop-off appointments for my two dogs before heading to work and ended up waiting 45 minutes after my appointed time before even being called. It was frustrating, especially since timing was important.

It seems like they may be understaffed, but regardless, communication needs improvement. The delays are often brushed off without much explanation or urgency, and while this may be a regular occurrence for them, it’s not great from a customer experience standpoint. A little more transparency and proactive management of the schedule would go a long way.
